bullish.title: CREDO Technology Group (NASDAQ:CRDO): A High-Growth Leader with Strong Momentum — CRDO clears CANSLIM screen with 231% EPS growth, 94.48 RS rating, and debt-free balance sheet.

neutral.title: Credo Technology Group Holding (CRDO) Showcased AI Interconnects, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
neutral.reason: 雖然公司在 AI 互連技術領域展現競爭力，但市場開始針對其股價是否已充分反映未來成長潛力進行估值辯論，屬於中性觀察。
